description: System invariants governing historical transition records and operator audit trails.

invariants.name: Append-Only Audit Evidence
invariants.quoted_invariant: Historical transition entries are durable evidence of past operator decisions. Never overwrite or delete historical lines.
invariants.rule: Preserve all historical status transition records as immutable, append-only logs.
invariants.drift_pattern: Deleting or editing past JSONL entries to scrub failed attempts or alter timestamps.

invariants.name: Tooling-Managed Transitions
invariants.quoted_invariant: Transitions are recorded via scripts/node_status_history.py during operator actions (gddp node browse).
invariants.rule: Generate status history entries exclusively through established control plane commands and designated scripts.
invariants.drift_pattern: Manually authoring arbitrary lines in node_status_history JSONL files.

invariants.name: Audit Trail Distinct from Graph State
invariants.quoted_invariant: Evidence, Not Live Status: Current graph status lives in gddp-config/graphs/<project>/nodes/*.yaml. This directory provides the audit trail explaining why status changed.
invariants.rule: Read current graph frontier status from node YAML definitions in gddp-config, using node_status_history purely for historical audit context.
invariants.drift_pattern: Querying node_status_history to determine current readiness or frontier dispatchability.
